what: Pig acoustic18 row, recomputed with experiments/audit/audit.py three_numbers(style='pig')
issue: the 18-feature table published with the Soundwel corpus covers 4331 of 5031 clips; for 700 clips every feature is absent. All 700 are NMBU (51% of that lab) and all carry the negative label, so under mean imputation they become one constant vector with a single label.
conclusion: the below-chance claim is an artefact of imputing rows the feature table does not cover; the leakage claim is unaffected and slightly stronger (+0.189 -> +0.208)
